rules.title: temp file/TOCTOU
rules.why_flagged: predictable temp path, or a check that is separate from the use it guards
rules.flag_condition: candidate for a predictable temp name; for access() followed within 20 lines by open/fopen; for stat/lstat followed by open/unlink/chmod; and for O_CREAT without O_EXCL. Those are multi-line proximity conditions and a same-line O_EXCL does not settle the other branches, so there is no skip path. Scout table records this rule as CWE-377/367; CWE-377 is carried on the record

rules.title: weak randomness
rules.flag_condition: candidate wherever the value is used for a security purpose. Also flag seeding from time(), getpid(), clock() or GetTickCount. Random( carries no trailing \b on purpose: a trailing \b after Random() would require a word character after the ) and Random(); would never match

rules.title: privilege management
rules.flag_condition: candidate when the return value is unchecked, when the drop order is wrong (setuid before setgid), when groups are not dropped, or when a world-writable mode is set. Scout table records this rule as CWE-273/271; CWE-273 is carried on the record

rules.title: unsafe signal handler
rules.why_flagged: signal handler registration; the handler body may call non-async-signal-safe functions
rules.flag_condition: take the SECOND argument (or the assigned symbol) as the handler name, then emit the candidate against THAT function's body: set function_range to the handler, not to the registration line, and put the registration file:line in entrypoint_hints. Without that the validator finds no caller and dismisses it as unreachable. Scout table records this rule as CWE-479/364; CWE-479 is carried on the record
rules.skip_clause: SIG_IGN, SIG_DFL and SIG_ERR are not handlers
